genius.notes: StablR Ltd remains the Malta MFSA-authorized EMI issuer. The reserve hub is an issuer disclosure linking quarterly independent reviews, not an auditor-authored report or monthly public attestation cadence. The August 25, 2026 recovery update says minting and redemption remain temporarily suspended; preserve redemptionPolicyPresent as existence of a policy, not current ability to redeem. The published terms restrict direct legal-entity customer eligibility by U.S. residence, control and representation criteria; these restrictions do not establish a universal ban on secondary-market holding. No token-specific GENIUS approval, official application or foreign registration was located in the dated scoped review. MiCA authorization does not establish a U.S. foreign-issuer exception. Expected Act effective date remains January 18, 2027; not-yet-restricted describes GENIUS timing rather than issuer service availability.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official pending application or registered foreign-issuer exception naming StablR Ltd/USDR was found in the opened issuer, OCC and Treasury materials or recorded exact-name regulator searches. No U.S. action naming the issuer was located in those searches or the opened OFAC 2026 chart. Foreign qualification remains unknown. This review does not rule out confidential or unindexed filings and does not treat the Malta operational incident as a U.S. enforcement action.
